purpose: Per-host, per-attempt evidence for the section 9.5 source-text re-fetch. Round 1 recorded the three Cowles reprints and Cowles DP 2331 as un-refetchable with digest "none"; round-2 findings LITERATURE-2-2 and QUANT-2-4 reported that claim as false. This log records every attempt made on 2026-09-02 with its scheme, host, status and content digest, so the claim is checkable rather than asserted.
failure_mode_identified: korora.econ.yale.edu serves the Phillips reprints over plain HTTP (port 80) and refuses TCP connections on port 443. The round-1 pass attempted HTTPS only and recorded "host did not accept a connection", which is true of port 443 and false of the host. cowles.yale.edu serves Cowles DP 2331 over HTTPS at the direct file path; the round-1 pass reached a landing page rather than the file path and recorded "returned HTML".
